articles.title: Man seriously injured in Brampton stabbing; suspect sought
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police (PRP) investigators are searching for a suspect following a stabbing in Brampton. Emergency crews were called to College Plaza near Steeles Avenue West and McLaughlin Road South around 5 a.m. on Monday. Paramedics transported the man to the hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries. Investigators have not released a suspect description at […]

articles.title: Toronto police surrounding U.S. Consulate after officers found evidence of gunfire outside building
articles.summary: Police say they found evidence of a firearm discharge outside the U.S. Consulate early Monday morning. The downtown consulate building was previously shot at on March 10.

articles.title: Toronto police investigating shooting near U.S. Consulate; suspect at large
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating after a gunshot was heard early Monday morning near the U.S. Consulate building in the city’s downtown core. Officers were called around 4:45 a.m. to the Armoury Street and University Avenue area, a zone that includes the consulate and several government buildings. articles.title: Driver seriously injured after vehicle slams into pole in Toronto’s west end
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a single‑vehicle collision early Monday after a male driver crashed into a pole in the city’s west end. articles.title: Boy, 11, hospitalized after scooter collision in Toronto’s west end; Police seek 2 drivers
articles.summary: Toronto police are investigating a collision in the city’s west end after an 11‑year‑old boy lost control of his electric scooter and struck a parked van, leaving him with significant injuries. articles.title: Toronto man, 29, wanted in Scarborough shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified a man who is wanted in connection with a shooting that happened in Scarborough over the weekend. Authorities say 29-year-old Bernell Prince Galloway is wanted for discharging a firearm. articles.title: Body found near train tracks in Brampton being investigated as suspicious death: police
articles.summary: Peel police say they are investigating a suspicious death after a body was found near train tracks in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: Hundreds of Torontonians celebrate after feds reject Billy Bishop jet expansion
articles.summary: Hundreds of Toronto residents and advocates are celebrating after the federal government rejected support for a proposed expansion to accommodate jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport.

articles.title: Carney calls August byelection for Beaches-East York riding
articles.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney has called three byelections in the B.C. riding of North Vancouver–Capilano, the Ontario riding of Beaches-East York and the Quebec riding of Chicoutimi—Le Fjord.

articles.title: Blaze damages 5 homes, displaces residents in Mississauga
articles.summary: Firefighters extinguished a house fire that spread to "several" nearby resident units in Mississauga on Saturday evening, Peel Regional Police said.

articles.title: SIU investigates early morning crash in Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating a crash that took place in Etobicoke early Saturday morning, said Toronto police.

articles.title: The Lower Don Trail is reopening after years of delays — but it's not quite finished yet
articles.summary: The section of Toronto’s Lower Don Trail between the Belleville Underpass and Queen Street East will reopen on Aug. 1. The reopening follows years of delays caused by unsuitable soil conditions and weather.

articles.title: Federal government says it won't support Ontario's Billy Bishop Airport expansion plans
articles.summary: The federal government says it won't support Ontario Premier Doug Ford's plan to expand Billy Bishop Airport to allow jets to take off and land there.
